title: A check refuses a waiting-page post whose home decision or ruling was not read in the same turn
why: Two owner items (784, 787) were posted for questions that decisions notes-merge-union and claude-md-change-is-flagged already rule. Incident 3 (00:37 CST Nov 14, triage): item 822 (child repos' lane lint unknown) was posted although ruling own-lint-skip-green-rollup-a (owner 21:01 CST Nov 13) already settled it; the coordinator caught it. Triage's check searched the flag's words (lint-unknown-ok, touched job) and found a ruling about a nearby act but not this one, because the ruling is worded "skip the lane lint ... rollup is green". The check must search the question's topic words in rulings, steps and decisions (lane lint, skip, rollup), and the poster lists what it searched. Incident 4, 01:50 CST Nov 14 (triage, final reading): posted page item 824 (pick-lane-hands-in-ready) after searching roadmap/rulings and steps only; the decision draft-until-reviewed (Q2, owner 09:44 CST Nov 12) was not searched or cited. The coordinator and the consultant withdrew the question at 01:46, the coordinator took that back at 01:47, then at 01:47 and 01:48 settled it: the later owner word, the standing grant "Lane draft PR" (17:19 CST Nov 12), is live (a lane never marks ready; only the batch runner does), Q2 is the earlier word, and the speed gain comes from runners marking each handed-in PR ready at once, which the grant already allows. So no owner question was needed: the item was a miss. Closed 01:48, reopened 01:50, closed again about 01:50 CST. The check must search docs/decisions on main as well as the rulings, and the post must name every owner word it finds, earlier and later, and which one is live. Same family as incident 3 (item 822).
source: Triage's own misses 18:40 and 19:15 CST Nov 13, found by the consultant and the red-main lane.
